hebrewText: כָּל מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּ/בָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר מָלַ֥ךְ בְּ/עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּ/בְ/אֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִ/יֶּ֣תֶר הָ/רְפָאִ֔ים וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַ/יֹּרִשֵֽׁ/ם

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: {dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)}
Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan
who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: to reign; inceptively, to ascend the throne; causatively, to induct into royalty; hence (by implication) to take counsel
tokens.kjv: consult, [idiom] indeed, be (make, set a, set up) king, be (make) queen, (begin to, make to) reign(-ing), rule, [idiom] surely.

tokens.bdb: Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan
tokens.kjv: Asharoth, Astaroth. See also H1045 (בֵּית עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), H6253 (עַשְׁתֹּרֶת), H6255 (עַשְׁתְּרֹת קַרְנַיִם).

tokens.bdb: Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine

he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant
tokens.kjv: leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

tokens.bdb: properly, an overhanging, i.e. (by implication) an excess, superiority, remainder; also a small rope (as hanging free)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] abundant, cord, exceeding, excellancy(-ent), what they leave, that hath left, plentifully, remnant, residue, rest, string, with.
giant, Rapha, Rephaim(-s). See also H1051 (בֵּית רָפָא).

tokens.bdb: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

tokens.explanation: Moshe — Moisés, o grande legislador e profeta de Israel

tokens.bdb: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants, and possessing in their place); by implication, to seize, to rob, to inherit; also to expel, to impoverish, to ruin
tokens.kjv: cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive(-ing) out, enjoy, expel, [idiom] without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit(-ance, -or) [phrase] magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, [idiom] utterly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.enLiteralWord: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.explanation: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
tokens.explanationEn: to occupy (by driving out previous tenants
